def normalize_status(status: str) -> str:
    return status.strip().lower().replace(' ', '_')

import importlib.util
import json
import pathlib
import sys

root = pathlib.Path.cwd()
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('devns_seed', root / 'src/devns_seed/__init__.py')
module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(module)
contract = module.normalize_status(' In Progress ') == 'in_progress'
out_dir = root / '.devns/artifacts/t3'
out_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
(out_dir / 'python-package.json').write_text(json.dumps({
    'projectType': 'python-package',
    'imports': True,
    'contract': 'pass' if contract else 'fail',
    'pytestStyle': 'deterministic'
}, indent=2) + '\n')
sys.exit(0 if contract else 1)
